model.title: Proposal for a DIRECTIVE OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Directives 2011/83/EU and 2002/58/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the simplification of certain consumer protection rules

whatsNext.text: Parliament's lead committee and the Council's working party examine it in parallel. No deadline applies at this stage; most files take one to two-plus years.
